call_purpose: You reached out because leads were coming in through your form, but the autoresponder email was not being sent to them.

resolved.text: You turned on the autoresponder option in your form settings and saved it, following our guidance.
You submitted a test form from another email address and confirmed that the autoresponder email arrived and everything is now working.

covered.text: We mentioned that these emails can sometimes land in spam, so verifying your sender domain is a good idea, and that this can be done in the email domain section of the settings.

customer_next_steps.text: Verify your sender domain in the email domain section of the settings.

technical_details.text: Sender domain verification is done in the email domain section of the settings.
